pageCache.text:
Vision and Values
Our Vision @ Oakbridge Federation
Our vision for Oakbridge is a federation that is passionate about success in academic progress and life achievements. We are driven by the goal to develop our children into effective learners, who are respectful, compassionate, self-confident young people, successful in their academic progress and life achievements.
Why we have a vision:
As a federation we have created a Vision so that our School communities and wider community are clear about our future and our direction of travel. Our Vision will be embraced by all stakeholders and is collectively owned by everyone. The core values of both schools will underpin their curriculum. Our vision sets out how we will all enable every child to achieve and become the best they possibly can.
How we will achieve it:
We will develop a curriculum around our children gaining a wealth of skills that are transferrable throughout their life in a meaningful context. Through the skills taught, our children will become resilient, reflective, creative, problem solving individuals ensuring that they have the tools to overcome challenges that they face throughout their lives.
We strive to ensure our children know where they come from, who they are and what they strive to become. Each child will develop the understanding of their own value as an individual and how they are able to contribute and engage in the local community and beyond, in a way in which possibly their parents felt they were unable to.
With the skills, knowledge and values that we harness, it is our intent for our children to be successful academically and prepare them for their next stages in life/education. The children of Oakbridge Federation should be able to articulate their success in every aspect of their school life and life as part of the community.
At Oakbridge Federation, the Leadership and Staff teams are continually developing, with high expectations of academic achievements and individual achievements. We work together and share expertise, growing success and being collectively responsible for everyone in our community. Through working collaboratively with our children, parents, staff and Governors and all stakeholders we will drive an innovative approach to teaching and learning and develop our place within the communities.

Welcome
Forster Park Primary is a large and friendly school in the London borough of Lewisham that prides itself on the warmth of its welcome to both children, parents and carers.
The diverse community represented at Forster Park by pupils and their families as well as staff, helps to create a learning environment which fosters a global understanding and appreciation of each other and the variety of cultures we bring to daily school life.
We are proud of the unique curriculum that we have created which reflects our community and puts our children at the core of all we do. Within it we promote the values of community, energy, ambition, curiosity, respect and adventure which are all so important to the adults of the future, who will soon be shaping our world.
At Forster Park School we believe that every child is entitled to enjoy their childhood. They should be valued for their individuality, culture and heritage. We provide an environment which is nurturing, stimulating and challenging.
This website gives you an insight into the school's ethos, where children feel secure and valued, as well as providing regular updated information for both parents, carers and pupils.
We hope that you enjoy your visit to our website and that you find the information you are looking for. Please contact the school directly if you have any queries.

pageCache.text:
Breakfast Club
Breakfast Club opens from 7:30am and is held in the school hall.
You can apply for breakfast club here: BREAKFAST CLUB REGISTRATION FORM
You can cancel breakfat club here: BREAKFAST CLUB CANCELLATION FORM
Alongside a healthy breakfast (READ THE MENU HERE) they provide a friendly happy and safe environment, with a daily variety of play and educational activities that get the children warmed up and ready to learn. At the end of the session all children are taken to their classes by the breakfast club staff.
You MUST NOT provide a ‘homemade breakfast’ for your child, unless previously agreed with the club manager, this is due to food allergies.
The cost per session from 2nd September 2026 is £2.80 per day. Please contact the school office for more information. Please remember that if your child does not attend, they will still be charged for the sessions. This is becuase we staff the club based on numbers.
As part of the government’s Plan for Change, 750 early adopter schools will be the first to access free breakfast clubs ahead of a national rollout across all primary schools. This will:
'At breakfast club, we get to play football on the astro-turf, if you are smaller you get to go on the soft play. Table football is one of our favourites and we have lots of other things to do like playing board games, lego and 'We Dance' together' Mo'Nique Lunan-Whitley, YR5

After School Club
After School Club
Contact us:
Email: asc@forsterpark.lewisham.sch.uk
Phone: 020 8373 6420 (3.30pm - 6.00pm)
Buddies @FP
Our after school club is run by Buddies @FP. The staff are teaching assistants at the school (Jill Collier, Mandy Barber and Liz Pendry). The club has 30 places for pupils to join the fun every day after school during term time (except the last day of each term). Pupils are collected from their classrooms at the end of the day and stay until 6.00pm.
Children are encouraged to try a variety of activities each day with all sorts on offer including ICT, art, book club, cooking and sporting activities to name but a few! Healthy snacks are provided and the children are encouraged to share the responsibilities by helping each other and getting stuck in.
The cost is £15 per session, this is paid termly/monthly in advance. Places can be booked through 'Kids Club HQ'. Below are the instructions as to how to set up the contract:
SET UP A CONTRACT WITH BUDDIES @ FP – GUIDE
Once you have set up your account, you can log in here:
LOG INTO BUDDIES @ FP BOOKING SYSTEM

We have learned bowling skills, including holding the ball correctly and releasing the ball at the right time. We use windmill arms and straight arms to avoid a “no ball” and are bouncing the ball on the floor before hitting the wicket. We are working in teams to see how many runs we can score! Parent App
At Forster Park, we use a pupil management system called 'Arbor' to manage the information that we hold for your child/ren.
The system comes with a useful parents' app that enables you to view and amend information about your children.
Please can you regularly log into the Arbor Parent’s app and check that all the details we hold for yourselves and your child/ren are correct.
If you haven’t already, please download the app from your app store on your mobile phone (Apple or Google Play), search for ‘Arbor’. You should have received a welcome email from us, if you have not please email the office on: info@forsterpark.lewisham.sch.uk
You can read detailed instructions here:
Arbor Instructions for Parents
Our app is used for many things including sending important messages, viewing your child’s attendance and much more.
Watch a helpful video here:
Parent App

Reception Tour
Welcome to Our Reception Class
We’re delighted that you’re considering our school for the start of your child’s learning journey. Our Reception class is a vibrant, nurturing environment where children are encouraged to explore, play, and grow—laying the foundation for a lifelong love of learning.
We warmly invite prospective parents to book a tour of the Reception class through the school office. This is a great opportunity to see our dedicated staff in action, explore the learning spaces, and get a feel for the welcoming atmosphere that makes our school so special.
Before your visit, we also encourage you to watch our Reception Walkabout Video, which offers a helpful insight into the classroom so that you and your child know what to expect.
To arrange a tour or find out more, please contact the school office — we look forward to welcoming you soon!
